Name: Panning Fix for Furry Farmer
Author: Sutodonez
Description:
This is just a simple graphic patch for FURRY FARMER mod, adding the missing panning graphics required in version 1.6.

All images used in this patch belongs to Stardew Valley Official and Furry Farmer Team.

[b]Original Mod[/b]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7618]FURRY FARMER[/url]﻿

PS: If you're using sleeves provided by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url], you don't need this patch for real. FS sleeves have their own panning graphics.

[b]Installation[/b]: Just copy the 10 images to [i]

[/i][quote][i]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Furry Farmer\assets\Characters\Arms 
[/i]
             ↑ Game Directory             ↑ Mod Directory[/quote]
and overwrite the old ones.
